text:
incident-bot: PAGER — P1: TP/NCCL collective hang detected on cluster-prod-4 (us-west2). Affected job(s): job-789 (customer: AcmePay). Symptoms: allreduce stuck, container crash on worker-3, CUDA Xid=79. Paging on-call @maria.

maria: I'm on it, joining bridge now.

incident-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridges/574321 (auto-bridge).

ajay: Ack. I see node-3 kernel logs: GPU0 Xid=79, container in restart loop. Marking as high impact.

lee: Quick log snippet from worker-3:```
[2026-03-17T12:01:12Z] NCCL WARN Allreduce step 4532 timeout
[2026-03-17T12:01:13Z] cudaErrorIllegalAddress on gpu1 (Xid=79)
[2026-03-17T12:01:13Z] container restart: exit code 137
```

devin: job-789 is tensor-pipeline parallel; all ranks stalled at the same step. Suspect hardware fault or NCCL communicator corruption, not just model.

sophia: Customer impact: AcmePay reports 5% of inference requests failing and ~30s latency spikes. Draft status: "Degraded - some requests failing for AcmePay. Mitigations in progress." Ok to post? :warning:

ajay: Starting live mitigation: cordon + drain node-3, restart affected pods on spare pool dedicated-burst. Command:```
kubectl cordon node-3
kubectl drain node-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force\```

ops-bot: cordon/drain jobs submitted by ajay. node-3 -> Cordoned. Evicting pods. Reschedule to pool:d-burst.

maria: I restarted the crashed container once but it hit Xid79 again. Skipping further restarts. Removing node-3 from rotation and letting scheduler reschedule.

lee: Initiating model fallback for affected route: rdw-large -> rdw-medium-quantized to reduce per-GPU memory pressure and avoid multi-GPU collectives where possible. Triggering rollout canary to 10%.

devin: Also enabling KV-prefix caching for the canary to reduce sequence length and KV growth.

sophia: Posting status update to status.redwood.io now: "Investigating collective communication failures affecting AcmePay; partial mitigation in progress; next update in 30m."

ajay: Confirmed pods for job-789 rescheduled to nodes 7 and 9 (spare pool). No Xid79 observed on those nodes so far. Traffic rerouted.

maria: On-call handoff plan: I'll stay for triage; postmortem owner: @lee. Assigning INC-2026-158. Please collect NCCL debug logs, dmesg + gpu crash dumps, and container core dumps.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-158 created and assigned to lee. Bridge will remain open for 2 hours.

sophia: Notifying AcmePay SRE contact "ops@acmepay" with the mitigation summary and ETA.

ajay: TL;DR: node-3 likely hardware/GPU fault causing NCCL communicator to hang -> crash. Evacuated node, rerouted jobs, rolled back to lower-memory model variant. Monitoring for regressions. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Monitoring hooks: perf dashboards + NCCL health checks enabled for affected model route. Alerts suppressed for rescheduled pods for 15m.

lee: A few follow-ups: collect /var/log/nvidia*, nv-nsight logs, and full NCCL debug output. I'll kick off a hardware ticket if GPU crash repros on node-3 after repro attempts.

maria: Thanks all — closing pager phase. Handoff to post-incident for root-cause and timeline. :white_check_mark:
